items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Joe Voyager, of course, wrote some nice tunes. Don't Leave Me Daddy and Bungalow of Dreams.

ctx.x: Who were some of those songwriters around that you remember?

Well, as we just mentioned, Erwin certainly wrote quite a number of good tunes, Triangle Rag and It's Too Late to Be Sorry. Joe Voyager, of course, wrote some nice tunes. Don't Leave Me Daddy and Bungalow of Dreams. That's a tune that I don't think too many people play, but I remember it well because Bix Baiderback made a nice record on it. Bix and Trumbau made a fine record on it.
